simple.summary: אַסְפָּתָא (ʼAçpâthâʼ) means Aspatha , a son of Haman First listed occurrence: Esth 9 7.

definitions.full: H630. Aspatha אַסְמָּ֑תָא proper name, masculine 3rd son of Haman Est 9:7 (Persian aspadâta , ab equo sacre datus according to Thes Add 71, after Pott & Benfey ).
